title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV mentions roughly tripled week on week (33 vs 12), but nothing this week names nirsevimab or infant antibodies; the visible RSV item is a pregnant user's post about paying out of pocket for a maternal RSV shot and being told the price would be higher after birth.
products.implication: Infant RSV protection is surfacing mainly as a parental cost question in the self-pay arena, and the maternal-versus-newborn pathway is being discussed by parents without an authoritative frame.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence and policy brief on infant RSV protection pathways and burden for discussions with paediatric and obstetric experts, and monitor parent forums for cost and access questions without engaging consumers directly.
products.signal_zh: RSV提及量較上週約成長三倍（33則，前週12則），但本週無內容提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體；可見的RSV內容為一名孕婦發文表示自費接種孕期RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV保護主要以家長費用疑問形式出現在自費領域，孕婦接種與新生兒保護兩種途徑由家長自行討論，缺乏權威框架。
products.action_zh: 準備中立的嬰兒RSV保護途徑與疾病負擔證據及政策簡報，供與兒科及婦產科專家討論；並監測家長論壇的費用與可近性問題，不直接與消費者互動。
who_zh: 婦產科醫師及產科診所
疾管署預防接種政策人員

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose mentions fell (12 vs 23), but opinion columns used the first public enhanced flu batch as a case for super-aged-society strategy, a fact-check stated the public enhanced flu vaccine is not mRNA, and several top-up stories referenced enhanced vaccines without saying whether extra enhanced doses were ordered. A Hong Kong outlet ran an efficacy-framed piece on a recombinant high-antigen vaccine for elders.
products.implication: The policy argument for widening enhanced-vaccine access is being made by commentators, while mRNA rumours and cross-market efficacy-framed content create accuracy and advertising-rule sensitivities.
products.action: Assemble an evidence and budget-impact pack on older-adult flu burden for advisory and legislative stakeholders ahead of next season's tender, and keep a factual Q&A ready on the vaccine's technology (not mRNA) for health bureaus and journalists who ask.
who: Taiwan CDC and immunisation advisory committee
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），65歲以上長照機構住民公費接種
products.signal_zh: 高劑量提及量下降（12則，前週23則），但評論專欄以首批公費加強型流感疫苗為例論述超高齡社會策略，事實查核指出公費加強型流感疫苗並非mRNA，多則增購報導提及加強型疫苗但未說明是否增購。一家香港媒體刊出以效力為訴求、介紹長者用重組高抗原疫苗的文章。
products.implication_zh: 擴大加強型疫苗可近性的政策論述由評論者提出，而mRNA謠言及跨市場效力訴求內容，則帶來資訊正確性與廣告法規上的敏感度。
products.action_zh: 在下一季採購招標前，彙整長者流感疾病負擔的證據與預算衝擊資料，提供給諮詢委員及立法相關利害關係人；並備妥說明該疫苗技術（非mRNA）的事實Q&A，供衛生局及記者詢問時使用。
who_zh: 疾管署及預防接種諮詢委員會
老年醫學及感染症專家
衛生政策評論者及立委助理

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Very little this week: Tdap volume is small (7 vs 5 mentions) and no current news or social item addresses Tdap or pertussis; the only related storyline, a medical-society appeal on vaccines for chronic lung disease, had no new mentions in the last 7 days.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from a respiratory conversation dominated by flu and COVID-19, so there is no live issue but also no visibility.
products.action: No reactive action needed; keep a background evidence file on adult and maternal pertussis protection ready for expert and society engagement when respiratory-season discussions widen.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週極少：Tdap聲量很小（7則，前週5則），目前無新聞或社群內容涉及Tdap或百日咳；唯一相關議題為醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗，近7天無新提及。
products.implication_zh: 在流感與COVID-19主導的呼吸道討論中，Tdap缺席，因此雖無即時議題，但也缺乏能見度。
products.action_zh: 無需回應行動；備妥成人及孕婦百日咳保護的背景證據資料，待呼吸道季節討論擴大時與專家及學會互動。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi, public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced that a publicly funded Novavax COVID-19 vaccine made by a different process will be offered from October 19 and that more Novavax doses are planned; multiple outlets relayed the start date and new supply.
products.implication: The October 19 start opens a period of high visibility in the public programme, where local availability, clinic readiness and early post-vaccination posts will shape perception.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC on delivery and allocation timing, give local health bureaus and contracted clinics a factual availability and storage Q&A, and set up monitoring for first-week posts about access or reactions.
who: Health reporters covering the joint campaign
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗，台灣由Sanofi代理，10月19日起公費接種
products.signal_zh: 疾管署宣布以不同製程生產的公費Novavax COVID-19疫苗將於10月19日起提供，並計畫增購Novavax；多家媒體轉述開打日期與新供貨。
products.implication_zh: 10月19日開打將開啟公費計畫的高曝光期，地方供應、診所準備度及早期接種後貼文將形塑觀感。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署協調配送及配發時程，提供地方衛生局及合約院所供應與儲存事實Q&A，並建立首週可近性或接種反應貼文監測。
who_zh: 報導聯合接種活動的衛生線記者

issues.title: Novavax public rollout start and local availability questions
issues.note: Taiwan CDC set the start date and plans more doses; expect questions on which sites have stock and early reaction posts in the first week.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費開打與地方供應疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署已訂開打日期並計畫增購；預期首週出現哪些接種點有疫苗的詢問及早期反應貼文。

issues.title: Shortage perception before top-up doses arrive and second stage opens
issues.note: Reports say the 474,000 extra public doses arrive in early November, as the second stage begins 2026-11-02, and one outlet reports public fears of shortage driving a rush.
issues.title_zh: 增購疫苗到貨及第二階段開放前的缺貨觀感
issues.note_zh: 據報47.4萬劑增購公費疫苗於11月初到貨，與2026-11-02第二階段開放時間相近；已有媒體報導民眾擔憂缺貨而湧入接種。

issues.title: COVID-19 misinformation and reaction posts amplifying with uptake
issues.note: A lung-CT anecdote drew about 8,500 engagements and other posts recycle heart and resurgence claims; a parent post on infant reactions to a public flu dose shows how individual experiences travel.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19錯誤訊息及反應貼文隨接種量擴散
issues.note_zh: 肺部CT軼事約獲8,500次互動，其他貼文重提心臟及疫情復燃說法；一則家長分享嬰兒接種公費流感疫苗反應的貼文，顯示個人經驗的傳播力。

self_pay.title: Self-pay cost burden for older adults
self_pay.note: A Rotary club, reported in the press, called self-paid vaccination costs a heavy burden and urged subsidies for vulnerable elders outside the eligible groups; the item concerns COVID-19 vaccination.
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體報導某扶輪社指自費接種費用負擔沉重，呼籲補助不符資格的弱勢長者；此事涉及COVID-19疫苗接種。

self_pay.title: Maternal and infant RSV priced in the private market
self_pay.note: One pregnant user posts that she paid out of pocket for an RSV shot and was told the price would be higher after birth; this is a single post, not verified pricing.
self_pay.title_zh: 孕婦及嬰兒RSV自費市場價格
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；此為單一貼文，價格未經查證。

self_pay.title: Little on clinic stock for enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: Rollout guides mention self-paid options alongside public doses and one report notes public shortage fears, but no item this week reports self-pay stock, prices or demand for adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所加強型流感或Tdap庫存資訊稀少
self_pay.note_zh: 接種指南於公費疫苗外一併提及自費選項，一篇報導提到民眾擔憂公費缺貨，但本週無內容報導含佐劑或高劑量流感疫苗或Tdap的自費庫存、價格或需求。
